decisions.reason: The decorative bouclé still has only a website mention, which suggests results are modest, but its carrying costs are low and slack lets the firm keep it while it fits the decorative range.
The flame-retardant jacquard serves the contract and hospitality segment, and its own product page signals performance at or above aspiration, so no search for other uses is triggered.

The wool-blend double-face fabric has low visibility and conflicts somewhat with the goal of fewer hard-to-recycle blends, which raises the withdrawal risk, but with no clear shortfall it stays for another season.
The wool leno fits the firm's design strength and its move to renewable materials, and in a growing industry there is no shortfall that calls for moving its resources elsewhere.
The newly launched braided fabric has its own product page and serves both upholstery and curtain uses, signalling commitment and results that are too early to judge below aspiration.
